checkpoints.name: qma_qcma_oracle_separation
checkpoints.description: Theorem 14.1 with the QMA containment of Bostanci-Haferkamp-Nirkhe-Zhandry (arXiv 2511.09551v2): beyond a size threshold depending only on the resource bound a*n^a, spectral Forrelation at gap 59/100 vs 57/100 has a constant-query QMA verifier (quantum witness on the first qQ work qubits with all other qubits pinned to |0>, qmaAcceptProb), and every classical-witness query algorithm within the bound misclassifies some instance. The Marriott-Watrous amplification, the matrix concentration (Claims 7.6-7.7) and the bosonic sampling upper bound (Theorem 9.1) are packaged as hypotheses.
